thread:
Maria G.: Kickoff — we need a concise playbook mapping benchmark narrative -> persona messaging -> inbound routing for the launch webinar. Deliverables: 2 slide bench/claims + 1-pager SDR cheat sheet by EOD Wed. Quick wins first. Thoughts?

Akash P.: +1. Recommend we focus on three primary personas: Platform Engineers (latency / cost), Product / Growth (time-to-market / developer DX), Security / Compliance (private deploys, KMS).

Neal R.: For Platform Eng, call out the p99 / tail story: our latest runtime run shows ~40% tail reduction vs CloudX endpoints at 4k token windows. We can pull the raw run and a flame graph. Need to verify final numbers.

Jon S.: Webinar angle suggestion: "Serving‑first: predictable LLM inference at scale" — live demo + failover/canary story. Include one short customer-like scenario (SaaS app with spikes). We should keep technical depth for breakout Q&A.

Maria G.: Routing sketch: high-intent webinar signups -> AE; low-intent -> nurture/drip; infra/compliance interest -> Solutions Eng / PS. Need concrete rule set we can drop into HubSpot / Segment.

Akash P.: Draft routing rules (plain text):

```
source:webinar_signup
- if company_size >= 1000 OR email_domain in enterprise_list -> route:ae-enterprise
- elif 'infrastructure' in usage_intent OR 'private' in usage_intent -> route:solutions-eng
- elif engagement_score >= 50 within 72h -> route:sdr-priority
- else -> route:marketing-drip
```

We'll implement via Segment -> HubSpot mapping. Anyone see gaps?

Neal R.: Add one more: if attendee selects "benchmark request" or uploads an evaluation prompt set -> route:solutions-eng (tag: eval-request). Also confirm: fallback bump to SDR on demo requests that happen post-webinar within 7 days.

Maria G.: Good call. We also need 3-line SDR hooks per persona (short, claim-backed, CTA). Example: "Cut inference tail latency in half vs managed endpoints — ask for our 2-min bench snippet." Keep legal-safe.

Jon S.: I'll draft hooks and the 10‑min webinar outline. Also propose we surface two benchmark blurbs on the landing page: (1) unit cost delta for long-context workloads, (2) tail latency stability under load — link both to the benchmark appendix.

Akash P.: I'll coordinate with runtime to extract numbers + screenshots from the bench harness and produce a 1-slide graph + callouts. ETA Tue 12:00pm.

Neal R.: I need read access to bench cluster logs for reproducible screenshots. @infra-oncall — can you confirm access?

infra-oncall: Granted read to 'bench-cluster-2026' for Neal R. and Akash P. until Wed EOD. :white_check_mark:

Maria G.: Action items recap:
- Jon S.: SDR hooks + webinar outline (due Tue 12pm)
- Akash P.: routing rules + bench screenshots (due Tue 12pm)
- Neal R.: verify benchmarking claims + reproducible steps (due Tue 12pm)
- Maria G.: compile 1-pager + SDR cheat (due Wed EOD)

Any blockers?

Neal R.: No blockers now. Will ping if the bench run needs re-run to reproduce specific tail numbers.

Maria G.: Great — sync scheduled 11:00am Tue to merge content and finalize the HubSpot mapping. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
